course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: It is preferable that students have already passed the first-year common subject 'Empresa' (Business).
It is preferable that students have passed several technology-related subjects directly linked to their future professional practice.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and provide a commercial vision to knowledge from other technological subjects.
Put into practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Relate with real external agents to the University (suppliers, clients, financial entities...) and know the organizations and instruments that support entrepreneurs.
Promote an entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.

syllabus_topics: Generalities: objectives, methodology and work plan of the subject.
The process of creating a technological micro-company: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, study approach and instruments.
Income statement (or profit and loss) and cash flow (or receipts and payments) budgets.

assessment_methods.method: Final exam: final presentation of the group project (EXA_FIN)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, if a minimum attendance of 75% is met, the final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA x 0.5 + EXA_FIN x 0.3 + PA x 0.2. A minimum score of 5 points is required to pass. Failure to meet the minimum attendance results in a "No Presentado" grade. For extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA x 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA x 0.4. A minimum score of 5 points is required to pass; students must notify the professor at least 4 weeks in advance and submit the business plan 48 hours before the exam.
